chunks: And Ibn Faddal narrated from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him:
Regarding a man who falls upon another man and kills him, and the one on top dies, he said: “There is no liability upon the one below.”

key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ: No liability or compensatory obligation is established.
key_terms.ٱلْأَسْفَلِ: The one underneath or below in the incident.
key_terms.ٱلْأَعْلَى: The one above or on top in the incident.

ai.seo_question: Is the person underneath liable if someone falls on him and the one above dies?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about accidental death resulting from one person falling upon another. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that when the upper person dies in such a case, the one beneath bears no liability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5193 - Ibn Faddal narrated from Ibn Bukayr from Abu Abdullah (as)

regarding a man who falls upon another man and kills him, and the one on top dies.
Imam (as) said: "There is no liability upon the one below."
